name: tugrr-admin
description: TUGRR Admin Portal - deploy both server and client

scripts.deploy: cd server && npm run deploy && cd ../client && npm run deploy && cd ..
scripts.deploy:server: cd server && npm run deploy && cd ..
scripts.deploy:client: cd client && npm run deploy && cd ..
scripts.install:all: cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install && cd ..
